name: pqcanary-vscode
description: Real-time post-quantum cryptographic security analysis, AST diagnostics, and NIST FIPS 203/204 automated remediation in VS Code.
author: Matvei Igumnov

commands.title: PQCanary: Scan Current File for Post-Quantum Vulnerabilities
PQCanary: Scan Entire Workspace for Cryptographic Deficits
PQCanary: Inspect Distributed PQMesh Fleet Status

pqcanary.enableRealtime.description: Enable real-time post-quantum cryptographic diagnostics as you type.

pqcanary.enableMeshSync.description: Synchronize cryptographic findings and heartbeats with the local PQMesh fleet bus.

pqcanary.meshUrl.description: URL to the PQCanary core daemon and PQMesh event bus.

pqcanary.minSeverity.description: Minimum severity threshold to report in editor diagnostics.

pqcanary.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before scanning on document changes.

pqcanary.serverUrl.description: URL to PQCanary local or remote web server.
